body: ADVISOR (2026-10-15 00:48): CONFIRMED. The stub control gets aida-generated no-op executables for each required_tools entry in PREFIX/bin (exit 0, no output, no project installer), so the tool-presence guard passes and the oracle measures behaviour, not tool absence. The guards stay active behind them. Record stub_tools=generated-noop in the control record. A real trial never receives generated tools.
subject: CONFIRMED: TASK-1731 stub no-op tools
